```ts
function terrainHeightAt(seed: string, planet: Planet, x: number, z: number): number {
  const worldCellX = Math.floor(x / CELL_SIZE_M);
  const worldCellZ = Math.floor(z / CELL_SIZE_M);
  const cX = Math.floor(worldCellX / CHUNK_SIZE);
  const cZ = Math.floor(worldCellZ / CHUNK_SIZE);
  const chunk = generateSurfaceChunk(seed, planet, cX, cZ);
  return chunk.heightmap[(worldCellZ - cZ * CHUNK_SIZE) * CHUNK_SIZE + (worldCellX - cX * CHUNK_SIZE)];
}
```
